text: elaine: Dropping a small design thread I prototyped a visibility toggle for permission presets + a 'scoped by default' checkbox on create. Want quick UX + a11y feedback. Figma: https://figma.com/rdw/perms-presets-toggle mike: Nice. Two quick notes: 1) the toggle label reads 'Show full perms' but when off it's unclear what users see. Maybe explicit: 'Show full permission names' / 'Hide full permission names'. 2) consider a tooltip explaining presets. samira: Accessibility: toggles need aria-checked and an accessible label that includes what changes. Suggested label: `Toggle detailed permission labels` and an aria-description: `When enabled, full permission names are shown inline; when disabled, compact chips are shown.` anna: UX: I like the 'scoped by default' checkbox for orgs, but default should be conservative (least privilege). We should also add an inline link: 'How to choose scopes' that opens a short help drawer. raj: From infra side, presets should map to stable backend identifiers (avoid free text). We'll surface the backend id in the slide-over for audits. Also add a compact telemetry tag when presets used so we can measure misuse. jo: Small front-end idea: when compact chips are enabled, add visually-hidden full names for screen readers: `generate: full name here` so chip remains short but accessible. marc: Empty state copy proposal for the keys list when presets exist: 'No keys yet — create a key from a preset to get started. Tip: choose a scoped preset to reduce risk.' Keep it friendly. mike: Also suggest an experimental inline badge: 'Default: scoped' that org admins can toggle. Helps team alignment. Make it clickable and open a modal to change default. samira: Keyboard flow: when the create modal opens, ensure the 'scoped by default' checkbox is first tabbable control after title. Screen readers should hear state. And announce changes to presets with aria-live polite: 'Default preset set to backend-only.' anna: We should add a brief microcopy under the preset selector: 'Presets are suggestions. You can customize scopes after creation.' Reduces trust friction. raj: Implementation note: allow admins to pin a preset at org level via API so UI can reflect that pinned state. Also we'll expose an endpoint to preview resulting token capabilities (helpful for non-engineers). jo: Security note: show a small warning pill when a selected preset includes admin-level perms: 'High risk' with contrasting color and accessible name 'High risk permissions included'. marc: A11y check: ensure the warning pill has >= AA contrast and that the pill receives focus if keyboard navigating to the permissions area. mike: For mobile, compact chips + toggle should not wrap weirdly. Maybe stack chips into two rows and keep toggle on its own row. Test with VoiceOver. samira: Also prefer short assertive aria-live messages for critical changes (e.g., switching default preset). Use polite for non-critical hints. deploy-bot: Visual diff job queued for branch `feat/presets-toggle` 8 snapshots; 0 failures so far. elaine: Thanks all. Action items: tweak toggle labels, add aria-description and live-region messages, add microcopy under presets, implement warning pill contrast, and wire org-level pin API. I'll update Figma and follow up.
